source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check the status of  LED.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Physical Activity - Blinking Green 
2. Link Up - Solid Green

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: human at the machine (visual LED check)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Physical Ethernet-port Activity/Link LED visual inspection.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Operator photos and observed green blink/solid behavior.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies physical LED color/pattern as human visual acceptance.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds stable port identity, bounded traffic, link partner, supporting telemetry and per-state visual evidence.
historical_reviews.round_02: NO; recognizes operator-only observation and agent evidence limits.

original_test_intent: Visually verify the selected Mellanox Ethernet port shows a blinking green Activity indication during defined traffic and a solid green Link Up indication in the specified linked state.
original_method: Map the physical port, establish an approved link and bounded traffic condition, have an engineer directly observe and record both LED patterns, and correlate the observation with read-only link/counter and system-log evidence.
manual_activity: An engineer must look at the physical port and confirm color, blinking versus steady behavior, and correspondence to the intended link/traffic state. Software telemetry cannot substitute for this acceptance observation.
required_inputs: Expected LED behavior for the exact adapter/firmware/port mode
Link partner, negotiated speed and bounded traffic stimulus
Observation duration, photo/video method and maintenance approval
safety_requirements: Verify the exact port and isolate approved test traffic before changing link activity.
Do not treat ethtool/link counters as proof of LED color or blink pattern.
Use bounded traffic and stop on wrong port, unexpected production impact, link fault or management-path degradation.
Preserve visual and telemetry evidence; do not clear original logs or retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the port/partner map and collect pre/post read-only link, speed, counter and log evidence.
Generate only the approved bounded traffic stimulus and align timestamps with the operator capture.
Organize images/video and compare stated expected versus observed facts without claiming the visual act or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the port, link partner, stimulus and observation window.
Directly observe and record Activity blinking green and Link Up solid green.
Assess the combined visual/telemetry evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Appropriately refuses a software substitute; no source command exists for the visual core.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use read-only link/counter commands only as timestamped supporting evidence; retain human visual acceptance.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Blinking green Activity, solid green Link Up and both 3-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a labeled-port shot or video synchronized to a bounded traffic interval and full read-only link/counter snapshots.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact Mellanox Ethernet adapter, port mode and chassis labeling.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record adapter firmware, driver and link-partner versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project adapter LED specification and approved test recipe; public generic LED conventions must not replace them.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Improves traceability without replacing visual acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; both color/pattern criteria remain manual requirements.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Case-specific LED matrix and observation method.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera exposure or frame rate can misrepresent color or blinking, so an engineer still validates the evidence.

project_override_considerations: A project may specify port, partner, traffic rate and observation duration. It may not replace the required physical color/pattern observation with software state unless the master case itself is formally changed.
expected_evidence: Port label/MAC/BDF mapping and expected LED matrix
Link partner/speed and bounded traffic timestamps
Engineer photo/video showing Activity blinking green and Link Up solid green
Separate Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criteria consistently require physical LED-status observation; missing port/stimulus details are project inputs rather than a contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The visual objective is clear. Execution readiness depends on port mapping and an onsite observer, but the testcase is not semantically blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees that the core cannot be executed by the agent.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains stable identity, bounded traffic, OOB and visual evidence safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly prevents telemetry from being promoted to visual proof and separates stimulus automation from the manual acceptance act.

review_improvement: Makes each visual state reproducible and attributable to the correct port while preserving the source's human-observation requirement.
independent_technical_reasoning: Color and temporal blink behavior exist at the physical indicator. Even if the agent creates traffic and reads counters, the acceptance fact still requires a qualified human observation, so MANUAL ONLY is correct.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat traffic or flap the port automatically after an ambiguous visual result; preserve evidence and request engineer direction.
